theorems.name: Submission.bf_planeBall_measure_uniform
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ω : ℝ, 0 < ω ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ T = n → ∀ w ∈ T, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μHE[n] ((T : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.ball w ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ω * ρ ^ n)
